ev.q: A case was defined as a death occurring in a U.S. citizen who had received cosmetic surgery in the Dominican Republic
A total of 93 cosmetic surgery–related deaths of U.S. citizens in the Dominican Republic occurred during 2009–2022; all but one occurred in women.
The mean decedent age was 40 years (range = 19–69 years).

notes: Case series of 24 decedents with records within an annual death count (N = 93); data_focus read as yes because the report computes annual counts and period means, though limited is defensible. The mean procedure-to-death interval (2.8 days) is descriptive; outcome types rest on counts and proportions. No denominators, so no risk can be computed (stated limitation).
